title: Reconstruction battle and federal troops
summary: Questions about the 1877 Canal Street battle; as a child she did not go about the city.

blocks.x: Yes. I was wondering about several things. Do you remember when they had the battle on Canal Street? At the foot of Canal? Mm-hmm. That was years and years ago. You may have just been a little girl then. Yes, I must have been. But that was during the reconstruction days.
I must have been very young then. Yes.
